summary: Lower a stable class getter to a C# property getter when receiver and prototype layout are statically known and accessor reflection is absent.

target.notes: Emit a C# property getter, virtual when override semantics are required.

caveats: Own data fields can shadow prototype accessors in JavaScript; receiver/property analysis must account for that.

tests.name: getter read
tests.input: class C { get x(){ return 3; } } console.log(new C().x);

tests.name: edge: descriptor reflection excluded
tests.expected_behavior: prints false; native C# property reflection is not equivalent and this rule must not match if descriptor behavior is observed
